title: MEIKO — That Same Excitement〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Alleyway

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (So, this wall is how they view RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And they're doing everything they can to surmount it. Despite how tall it is...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, it's just so big...
se_walk_women_001_1
MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku, hello.
Can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay...
Have you been thinking about the wall again today?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, my mind just keeps drifting back towards it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I knew that surpassing RAD WEEKEND wouldn't be easy. Even so...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's hard not to feel a little overwhelmed when you see a physical representation of it like this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For some strange reason, as tall as this wall is, I'm certain that they'll figure out a way over it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me too...
Especially considering how ironclad their dedication is.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's thanks to that that the wall cracked.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We even get to hear music coming from the other side now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku, you weren't there when Kohane said this, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If we do end up surpassing RAD WEEKEND and cause this wall to come crumbling down...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a feeling that music from all around the world will come together in the plaza back there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND, this wall will come down, we'll get to learn about all this music from around the world and keep growing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's such an exciting thought! This place is going to be so incredible!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
She said that?
But I understand Kohane's excitement.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, me too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, I feel just as excited as she does...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The thought of music from all over the world playing in that plaza is so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can't wait to see what she and the others are like after they've had a chance to see what the world has to offer...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hence my excitement.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Now I'm getting all excited.
Aha! There you two are!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've been looking all over for you two after seeing that you weren't at the cafe!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorry if we caused you all some concern.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
But can we ask what you were doing here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Nothing much.
We were just talking about how we can't wait to see what happens after this wall comes down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What she said.
And you'll all need to do your best to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We know.
You don't have to remind us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, you were looking for us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, so... We were hoping to get some advice about this one part we've been having trouble singing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course, we'd be happy to help.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, but... I was actually thinking about singing, so would it be possible for me to join you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?! You wanna sing with us...?!
Yes, you're more than welcome to!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, please do!
We'd love to sing with you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's head over to the plaza.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!
